Basic video editing and motion graphics

Strong creative thinking and visual storytelling skills.
Excellent attention to detail and a strong eye for aesthetics.

Comfortable managing multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced hotel environment.

Quality, creativity, and consistency of all visual communications.
